public_source_heads.source_scope: Windows raw-fd API/position semantics, release-level locking correctness, dependency floor selection

exact_continuation: Treat portalocker>=4.2 as the first defensible dependency floor for the inspected Windows low-level locking surface, then source-map/implement the event authority with existing os.open(...,0600) raw fd + LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB, retrying only AlreadyLocked. Add candidate011 pre-rotation one-byte delimiter isolation, but make stable generation iteration byte-based so a torn UTF-8 code point cannot poison later valid rows. POSIX readers may pin handles/end offsets under shared flock; Windows correctness scans hold exclusive event authority. Then enforce events.lock -> mission-view.lock and finish PlannerVerdict FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN plus explicit iter_call_events corruption behavior. Keep candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition provenance separate.

run_findings.candidate_012_dependency_floor: Revised to portalocker>=4.2 as the first defensible floor for Argus's inspected raw-fd Windows locking surface. Upstream 4.0 fixed raw-fd current-position mutual-exclusion failure; 4.1 changed no runtime behavior; 4.2 fixed further Windows locker correctness including shifted fallback LK_* values and one cached OVERLAPPED reused across calls/threads. Argus Python>=3.11 has no Python-version cost, and current Windows CI resolves latest rather than the declared minimum.
run_findings.candidate_012_scope_guard: This does not prove every Argus path fails on portalocker 3.2/4.0/4.1. Inspected raw-fd acquisitions start at offset zero and workspace_lease advances only after acquisition. The claim is dependency-policy based: a <4.2 floor knowingly admits upstream-known low-level Windows defects in the API family Argus directly uses.
run_findings.candidate_009_mode_preservation: With a >=4.2 floor, event authority can preserve os.open(...,0600) and pass the raw fd directly to low-level Portalocker; separate os.fdopen conversion is unnecessary for Windows byte-zero correctness. Retry only AlreadyLocked, propagate permanent acquire failures, and treat unlock failure after committed append as cleanup before close.
run_findings.candidate_011_ordering_revised: Boundary isolation remains before _maybe_roll(): if nonempty current log does not end in newline, append exactly one newline under event authority before rotation, never truncate the damaged bytes.
run_findings.candidate_011_utf8_coupling: Delimiter isolation alone is insufficient when process interruption tears a multibyte UTF-8 sequence. A local probe showed strict UTF-8 iteration raises UnicodeDecodeError before a later valid Planner verdict row, while binary physical-row iteration still reaches it. Stable generation reading must therefore be byte-based with per-row decode/parse status.
run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after a complete stable clean scan; UNKNOWN covers snapshot/open/decode/target-relevant parse ambiguity, leaves outbox pending, and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation.
run_findings.candidate_007_windows_bootstrap_race: Mission View cross-platform reconciliation still needs event authority plus strict events.lock -> mission-view.lock and a writer projection entry point that does not recursively reacquire event authority.
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no power-loss incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
run_findings.control_freeze: semantic work froze on note SHA 3ec8df30be44c52bebc80f18dcfb2b8dba4a05df control15/config6; later note heads were used only for authorized write coordination and were not adopted semantically
